summary: Backend + Frontend E2E validation of new features: Integrazione dossier (25 EUR), Consensi tab & CSV export, dossier-create dialog without notes + questionnaire hint, integration-info-banner. 13/13 pytest backend tests PASS. Full Stripe E2E integration payment flow verified (checkout → success redirect → integration_pending=True → patient upload allowed → admin summary-file clears flag). Doctor Consensi tab shows 5 records including mario.rossi@test.it and consent.test@test.it with working CSV export button.
critical_code_review_comments: fulfil_payment.integrazione branch correctly sets integration_pending=True and pushes entry into integrations array on the dossier.

create_checkout + paypal_create_order both enforce: (a) dossier must be completato, (b) no existing integration_pending, (c) integration_type ∈ {nuovi, dimenticati}. All three branches return HTTP 400 with clear Italian messages.
upload_files and delete_file gate on dossier.status=='completato' AND NOT integration_pending → correct behavior: patient can add files during integration window only.
upload_summary_file (admin-only) auto-clears integration_pending in the same $set — clean single-write update.

/api/admin/consents excludes _id via projection ({'_id':0}). /api/admin/consents/export returns text/csv with proper Content-Disposition attachment and semicolon-separated header. Both require admin (require_admin) → 403 for patient, 401 for unauthenticated.
Frontend integration-section only renders when completed && !integration_pending; pending-section takes over when in pending state — good UX separation.
Info banner (integration-info-banner) is unconditionally rendered on any dossier page including bozza/pagato/completato — matches spec of 'under upload area on any dossier page'.
Minor: PATIENT UI login redirects mario.rossi to /consenso because the seed user has no consents_version. Documented in test_credentials.md — acceptable.

Note: Existing dossier doss_fbbdfe2a258f is NOT in completato state (still 'in attesa di pagamento') so integration section not visible there — used doss_ccab969771cc (created by test) for E2E verification. Not a bug.
test_credentials: Admin spitaleri.pietro@gmail.com / DossierMedico2026! and Patient mario.rossi@test.it / Test1234! both work. Patient UI first login goes through /consenso.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ dossiers for mario.rossi via API (TEST integr valid, TEST upload gating, etc.) — several are now in 'completato' state. doss_ccab969771cc used for E2E integration payment; it now has: integration_pending=false (cleared), 1 integrations entry {type:'nuovi', paid_at:...}, summary_file attached (tiny placeholder PDF). Admin patched dossiers to 'completato' during tests. Consider periodic cleanup.

E2E Stripe integration payment path was exercised live via Playwright with test card 4242... in Italy country to bypass US phone/state requirements.
